role_sought: Municipal councillor / Mayor of Les Voivres
detail: In the 2026 municipal elections, the list led by Michel Fournier was the only one standing in Les Voivres (a village of around 280 inhabitants) and won 100% of votes cast, taking all 11 municipal council seats. He was subsequently re-elected mayor.

role_sought: Municipal councillor / Mayor of Les Voivres
result: Elected; installed as mayor on 18 May 2020
detail: Re-elected to the municipal council and installed as mayor of Les Voivres on 18 May 2020 following the 2020 municipal elections. Detailed vote figures for this small commune are not readily available.

election: Municipal mandate, Les Voivres (Vosges) — successive elections since 1989
detail: First elected to the Les Voivres municipal council in 1983 and elected mayor in 1989. Has been continuously re-elected mayor across successive municipal terms. Detailed historical vote shares for this small rural commune are not publicly compiled.
